title: C482/104/2014 of Sri Jai Datt Sharma Vs Smt. Varsha Sharma

paras.text:
MCRC No. 27 of 2014
In
C482 No. 104 of 2014
Honíble V.K. Bist, J
Mr. Ranjan Ghildiyal, Advocate, present
for the petitioner.
Heard.
On 05.02.2014, the petitionerís counsel
was permitted to withdraw the application
under Section 482 Cr.P.C., with liberty to seek
appropriate remedy before the appropriate
forum.
This miscellaneous application has been
moved by the petitioner for returning him the
certified copy of the impugned order i.e. the
order passed by Special Judicial Magistrate,
Rishikesh, Dehradun on 21.06.2013.
The application is allowed. Registry is
directed to return the certified copy of the
order dated 21.06.2013 to the counsel for the
petitioner. It is further directed that photo copy
of the order be kept on record.
 (V.K. Bist, J)
Parul 18.02.2014
